title: Application to Study Permit Process Steps for Poland
notice: ঢাকায় কোনো Polish Embassy নেই। ভিসার জন্য New Delhi (India) যেতে হবে — আগে Indian Visa নিন।

processSteps.label: NAWA Syrena Verification : mandatory since 1 July 2025
bullets: Apply free at syrena.nawa.gov.pl — upload admission letter, receive Confirmation Letter
Required for visa application — can be completed from Dhaka

processSteps.label: University Application : via university portal or study.gov.pl
bullets: Application window: January–June for October intake

processSteps.label: Book Dormitory / Accommodation
bullets: Apply for university dormitory immediately after admission — spots fill quickly
Housing confirmation letter required for visa | Cost: 500–2,500 PLN/month

processSteps.label: Financial Proof : Credit Card min 10,912 PLN limit
bullets: Polish Embassy New Delhi does NOT accept Bangladeshi bank statements
Formula: 701 PLN × 12 months + 2,500 PLN = 10,912 PLN minimum

processSteps.label: Fill Visa Form on e-Konsulat Portal
bullets: Complete at secure2.e-konsulat.gov.pl — handwritten forms NOT accepted
Print, sign, obtain Indian Visa first, then submit at VFS Global India New Delhi

costSteps.label: MoFA Apostille : per document — Bangladesh in Hague Convention since 30 March 2025
Indian Visa : required to travel to New Delhi for Poland visa submission
Polish National D Visa Fee : €200 (from January 2026) — paid at VFS India
VFS Global India Service Fee : check vfsglobal.com/Poland/India for current fee
Air Ticket to Poland : varies by season and route
Karta Pobytu (Residence Card) : PLN 440 (~€103) — paid after arrival

resources.label: NAWA — Polish National Agency for Academic Exchange
